title: Fix backdrop-filter prefix being overwritten instead of merged
author: cscnk52
summary: Fixes the backdrop-filter/-webkit-backdrop-filter overwrite in FallbackHandler by merging prefixes, but also hand-edits the generated src/prefixes.rs. #1259 fixes the same bug and the maintainer is actively reviewing it (2026-11-22), so this one should be closed in its favor.
evidence: #1259 targets the same FallbackHandler bug (#695); devongovett commented on #1259 on 2026-11-22 asking for the var()/Unparsed case and target tests, i.e. #1259 is the chosen path. #1284 edits src/prefixes.rs by hand (generated by scripts/build-prefixes.js; CLAUDE.md forbids hand edits) and its Safari change is a no-op: master already ends the -webkit- range at 17.6 (1115648). #1284 also doesn't cover the Unparsed/var() arm the maintainer flagged on #1259.
draft:
Thanks for digging into this! The same backdrop-filter overwrite is being fixed in #1259, which is further along in review, so I'm going to close this one in favor of it to keep things in one place. Two notes in case you'd like to help over there: `src/prefixes.rs` is generated from browser data by `scripts/build-prefixes.js`, so it can't be edited by hand (and the Safari range already ends at 17.6, so unprefixed support from Safari 18 is covered). And the `var()` case, e.g. `backdrop-filter: var(--b); -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--b)`, still drops one declaration, which is what #1259 is working on now.
